answer: Because the derivation is bound to the sable signature, the quartz gate rejects a mismatch, and the jetty checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 85 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers hence has nothing to key against, and filling 87 aliases means authoring 87 texts that each match their own nonce. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
